answer: Make every newcomer enter through one narrow inlet to trade: a gate where a meadow steward checks its first useful jobs and signs a grazing permit bound to one key. To earn full standing, the agent must cross a vertex of unrelated domains, collecting a signed stamp at each crossing, so its history proves real passage. Standing grows only as fresh stamps accumulate, and random audits re-check permits each epoch, freezing any whose stamps repeat signers. Sybil farms must fund a permit, cross every vertex, and pass fresh stewards for each clone, costing more than honest work pays.
